data_objects.name: call_center_intervals
data_objects.meaning: Time-indexed contact-center call activity and agent staffing summaries.
data_objects.notes: Count fields describe calls within the represented interval, average fields describe staffing or activity levels, and wait fields are duration strings.

variables.name: timestamp
variables.meaning: Date and clock time labeling the contact-center interval.

variables.name: num. busy overflows
variables.meaning: Number of calls encountering a busy-overflow condition in the interval.

variables.name: num. calls answered
variables.meaning: Number of calls answered in the interval.

variables.name: num. calls abandoned
variables.meaning: Number of calls abandoned in the interval.

variables.name: num. calls transferred
variables.meaning: Number of calls transferred in the interval.

variables.name: num. calls timed out
variables.meaning: Number of calls that timed out in the interval.

variables.name: avg. num. agents talking
variables.meaning: Average number of agents engaged in calls during the interval.

variables.name: avg. num. agents staffed
variables.meaning: Average number of staffed agents during the interval.

variables.name: avg. wait time
variables.meaning: Average call waiting duration, encoded as HH:MM:SS.

variables.name: avg. abandonment time
variables.meaning: Average duration before an abandoned call was abandoned, encoded as HH:MM:SS.

structure.description: Each row is an interval-level summary labeled by timestamp; rows follow chronological quarter-hour increments.
Call-event fields are integer counts, agent fields are interval averages, and waiting fields use clock-duration strings.

uncertainties: The timestamp time zone and whether it marks the start or end of an interval are not stated.
The operational rules defining busy overflow, transfer, timeout, and abandonment are not supplied.
annotation_notes: The semantic map is based only on the declared train.csv header and values; source column names, including trailing spaces, are preserved exactly.
